builds.name: Reference: Ranked bot core
builds.goal: Reference for Ezreal: the core and runes ranked Emerald+ bot players use most (41,419 ranked Emerald+ games with this core on OP.GG, patch 16.20, 50.2% win rate).
builds.hypothesis: A mobile ranged skirmisher who lands repeated Qs to recover cooldowns and mixes attacks with mark detonations. The current adc provider core anchors this plan; later slots are observed options or reviewed kit completions. Core in purchase order: Trinity Force → Muramana → Spear of Shojin. Lethal Tempo keystone as played in those games. Remaining slots: Ionian Boots of Lucidity, Serylda's Grudge, Guardian Angel.
builds.summary: The proven bot baseline: Trinity Force → Muramana → Spear of Shojin, with Lethal Tempo.
testPlan: Play it in bot as your control build. Follow the purchase order; the core (Trinity Force → Muramana → Spear of Shojin) is what ranked players complete first.
Record kills, deaths, damage dealt and the minute you finish each core item, then compare other builds against these numbers in similar games.
Adapt the last two items to the enemy team: armor or magic resist against fed carries, anti-heal against healing, penetration once enemies stack resists.
failureConditions: Your results with this build fall clearly below the 50.2% ranked baseline over several games in the same role.
The enemy team composition makes the core items poor answers; swap the flexible slots before abandoning the core.
tradeoffs: Proven and predictable, so opponents know what to expect. It is a starting point, not the best build for every matchup.
The observed core and individual options do not establish six-item build statistics. Late slots are kit-based inferences.
Six-slot completion is our kit-based inference, not an observed six-item win-rate build.  Situational options replace an appropriate slot; they are not added as a seventh item.
buyOrder: Core in purchase order: Trinity Force → Muramana → Spear of Shojin.
Boots after the first item unless the lane needs them earlier.
coverageNotes: Source: OP.GG ranked Emerald+ solo/duo, patch 16.20, checked 2026-10-14. Core items and rune page are observed; later slots are observed options or reviewed completions. Win rates describe those games, not a prediction for yours.

kitEvidence.formula: Ezreal teleports then fires a bolt at the nearest enemy, dealing [80 / 130 / 180 / 230 / 280 + (0.6) × AD[statFormula=2] + (0.75) × AP] magic damage. The bolt prioritizes enemies affected by Essence Flux.
Ezreal fires a bolt of energy, dealing [20 / 45 / 70 / 95 / 120 + (1.3) × AD + (0.4) × AP] physical damage to the first enemy hit and reducing his Ability Cooldowns by [1.5] seconds.
Ezreal's Ability hits grant him @AttackSpeedPerStack.0*100@% Attack Speed for [6] seconds, stacking up to [5] times.

Ezreal fires a magical orb that sticks to the first champion, structure, or epic jungle monster hit for [4] seconds. If Ezreal hits that target with an Attack or Ability, it detonates, dealing [80 / 135 / 190 / 245 / 300 + (1) × AD[statFormula=2] + (0.9) × AP] magic damage. Detonating with an Ability refunds the Mana cost of that Ability plus [60] Mana.

Ezreal fires a massive energy arc that deals [350 / 550 / 750 + (1) × AD[statFormula=2] + (1.1) × AP] magic damage. Damage to minions and non-epic jungle monsters is reduced to [150 / 225 / 300 + (1) × AD[statFormula=2] + (1.1) × AP] magic damage.

builds.name: Flux Shift Refund
builds.summary: Measure net mana spent and W/E hit reliability.
builds.goal: Measure net mana spent and W/E hit reliability.
builds.hypothesis: W detonated by an ability refunds that ability's cost plus 60 mana; E prioritizes W marked targets and has 0.75 AP. Luden/AP penetration supports the W/E magic sequence while Cosmic helps leave. Q remains physical even with its AP ratio.
testPlan: Required state: W sticks to the intended champion and E chooses it without exposing Ezreal.
Measure net mana spent and W/E hit reliability; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: W miss changes E targeting and removes the refund; AP loses attack damage.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: W attachment alone does not deal the detonation damage.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Luden's Echo, Cosmic Drive, Shadowflame, Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Sorcerer's Shoes. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.name: Situational adaptation: Critical duel
builds.goal: Situational adaptation for Ezreal: adapt to the specified fight rather than assume one universal build
builds.hypothesis: A mobile ranged skirmisher who lands repeated Qs to recover cooldowns and mixes attacks with mark detonations. Confirm Q on-hit/Spellblade behavior and W mark detonations; count Q hit rate and ordinary attacks. Manamune transformation and repeated R damage are not guessed from base stats. Crit attacks and a conditional shield test repeated duel windows.
builds.summary: Crit attacks and a conditional shield test repeated duel windows.
testPlan: Kit question for Ezreal: Confirm Q on-hit/Spellblade behavior and W mark detonations; count Q hit rate and ordinary attacks. Manamune transformation and repeated R damage are not guessed from base stats.

Start with the early core (Kraken, then Navori if attack-driven recycling works) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Compare against the reference route at the same level, gold spent, finite stacks and opponent setup. Record unused gold; isolate an item change before changing runes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Crit attacks and a conditional shield test repeated duel windows. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern. Choose the opponent profile this defensive route is intended to address, then repeat against the wrong damage type.

Q evidence: Ezreal fires a damaging bolt of energy which reduces all of his cooldowns slightly if it strikes an enemy unit. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: A Lifeline slot excludes Sterak/Maw; melee access or ranged spacing must be earned.

The route fails Ezreal's stated kit question: Confirm Q on-hit/Spellblade behavior and W mark detonations; count Q hit rate and ordinary attacks. Manamune transformation and repeated R damage are not guessed from base stats.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: A Lifeline slot excludes Sterak/Maw; melee access or ranged spacing must be earned.
Full cost 16,550 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
Counter-items are conditional. Change boots/defense for the real matchup, then record the modified setup.
buyOrder: Kraken, then Navori if attack-driven recycling works. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Infinity Edge, Immortal Shieldbow, Lord Dominik's Regards are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

builds.name: Mystic Haste Survival
builds.summary: Count E reavailability across a fixed number of Q hits.
builds.goal: Count E reavailability across a fixed number of Q hits.
builds.hypothesis: Each Q hit reduces ability cooldowns by 1.5 seconds. Shojin and haste support repeated landing opportunities; Trinity adds cast-attack value and Muramana supplies earned mana/AD. Frozen Heart survival buys more Q attempts while Serylda supports physical Q damage.
testPlan: Required state: Have an unobstructed Q lane and a completed Tear transformation. Record the earned Muramana transformation and finite max mana.
Count E reavailability across a fixed number of Q hits; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Front-unit interception or missed Q removes the proposed cooldown acceleration.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: The extracted Q tooltip does not itself prove Spellblade/on-hit transmission through Q; log it.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
